def font(size: int, weight: str = "normal", family: str = "Segoe UI") -> tuple:

def big_button(parent, text, command=None, bg=CYAN, fg=BG, size=20, width=None, pady=14):
    """Large flat button with hover colour."""
    btn = tk.Button(
        parent,
        text=text,
        command=command,
        bg=bg,
        fg=fg,
        font=font(size, "bold"),
        relief="flat",
        activebackground=bg,
        activeforeground=fg,
        bd=0,

        cursor="hand2",
        pady=pady,
    )
    if width is not None:
        btn.configure(width=width)
    # Hover: lighten by blending toward white a bit
    darker = _blend(bg, "#000000", 0.15)
    btn.bind("<Enter>", lambda e: btn.configure(bg=darker))
    btn.bind("<Leave>", lambda e: btn.configure(bg=bg))
    return btn


def _blend(hex_a, hex_b, t):
    """Blend two #RRGGBB colours, t = amount of b (0..1)."""
    a = hex_a.lstrip("#")
    b = hex_b.lstrip("#")
    ra, ga_, ba = int(a[0:2], 16), int(a[2:4], 16), int(a[4:6], 16)
    rb, gb, bb = int(b[0:2], 16), int(b[2:4], 16), int(b[4:6], 16)
    r = int(ra + (rb - ra) * t)
    g = int(ga_ + (gb - ga_) * t)
    bl = int(ba + (bb - ba) * t)
    return f"#{r:02X}{g:02X}{bl:02X}"

from __future__ import annotations

import tkinter as tk

from ..game.game import Game
from ..questions.repository import QuestionRepository
from ..users import ScoreRepository, User
from . import theme
from .intro_screen import IntroScreen
from .menu_screen import MenuScreen
from .name_screen import NameScreen
from .question_screen import QuestionScreen
from .end_screen import EndScreen
from .highscores_screen import HighScoresScreen
from .help_screen import HelpScreen
from .admin_screen import AdminScreen


class App:
    """Owns the root window, repositories, and screen switching."""

    DB_PATH = "data/spacefractions.db"

    def __init__(self, root: tk.Tk, db_path: str | None = None):
        self.root = root
        self.db_path = db_path or App.DB_PATH
        self.questions = QuestionRepository(self.db_path)
        self.scores = ScoreRepository(self.db_path)

        self.username: str = ""
        self.user: User | None = None
        self.game: Game | None = None
        self.round_questions: list = []
        self.current_index: int = 0

        self._screens = {}
        self._current = None

        self.root.bind("<F11>", self._toggle_fullscreen)
        self.root.bind("<Escape>", self._leave_fullscreen)

    # ---- navigation ----
    def register(self, name: str, screen) -> None:
        self._screens[name] = screen

    def show(self, name: str) -> None:
        if self._current is not None:
            self._current.pack_forget()
        screen = self._screens[name]
        screen.refresh()
        screen.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self._current = screen

    # ---- fullscreen ----
    def _toggle_fullscreen(self, _event=None) -> None:
        state = self.root.attributes("-fullscreen")
        self.root.attributes("-fullscreen", not state)

    def _leave_fullscreen(self, _event=None) -> None:
        self.root.attributes("-fullscreen", False)

    # ---- game flow helpers ----
    def start_round(self, count: int = 10) -> None:
        self.game = Game(game_id="round")
        self.round_questions = self.questions.sample(count)
        self.current_index = 0

    def next_question(self):
        if self.game is None or self.current_index >= len(self.round_questions):
            return None
        q = self.round_questions[self.current_index]
        self.current_index += 1
        return q

    def remaining(self) -> int:
        return max(0, len(self.round_questions) - self.current_index)

    def save_score(self) -> None:
        if not self.game or not self.username:
            return
        self.scores.add_score(
            self.username,
            self.game.score,
            self.game.total,
            self.game.percentage(),
            self.game.stars(),
        )


APP_FONT = theme.font


def create_app(root: tk.Tk, db_path: str | None = None) -> App:
    """Build the full application WITHOUT calling mainloop()."""
    root.title("Space Fractions")
    root.configure(bg=theme.BG)
    root.minsize(1100, 750)
    try:
        root.state("zoomed")
    except tk.TclError:
        try:
            root.attributes("-zoomed", True)
        except tk.TclError:
            pass

    app = App(root, db_path=db_path)

    screens = [
        IntroScreen(root, app),
        MenuScreen(root, app),
        NameScreen(root, app),
        QuestionScreen(root, app),
        EndScreen(root, app),
        HighScoresScreen(root, app),
        HelpScreen(root, app),
        AdminScreen(root, app),
    ]
    for s in screens:
        app.register(s.name, s)

    app.show("intro")
    return app

import tkinter as tk

class IntroScreen(tk.Frame):
    name = "intro"

    def __init__(self, parent, app):
        super().__init__(parent, bg=theme.BG)
        self.app = app
        self._after_cb = None
        self._anim = None

        self.canvas = SpaceCanvas(self)
        self.canvas.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        self.title = tk.Label(
            self.canvas, text="Space Fractions", bg=theme.BG, fg=theme.YELLOW,
            font=theme.font(44, "bold"),
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 180, window=self.title)

        self.subtitle = tk.Label(
            self.canvas, text="Blast off and master fractions!",
            bg=theme.BG, fg=theme.CYAN, font=theme.font(22),
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 260, window=self.subtitle)

        self.skip_btn = theme.big_button(
            self.canvas, "Skip", command=self._skip, bg=theme.PINK, size=18, pady=8,
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(1000, 60, window=self.skip_btn)

        # Rocket (drawn on canvas, animated)
        self._rocket_x = 100

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self.canvas.draw_background()
        self.canvas.twinkle()
        self._rocket_x = 100
        self._animate()
        self._after_cb = self.after(6000, self._skip)

    def _animate(self) -> None:
        self._rocket_x += 8
        w = self.canvas.winfo_width() or 1100
        if self._rocket_x > w + 60:
            self._rocket_x = -60
        self.canvas.delete("rocket")
        x = self._rocket_x
        y = 500
        self.canvas.create_polygon(
            x, y, x + 12, y - 30, x + 24, y, fill="#FFFFFF", outline="", tags="rocket"
        )
        self.canvas.create_oval(
            x + 8, y - 10, x + 16, y + 2, fill=theme.CYAN, outline="", tags="rocket"
        )
        self.canvas.create_polygon(
            x + 8, y, x + 16, y, x + 12, y + 22, fill=theme.YELLOW, outline="",
            tags="rocket",
        )
        self._anim = self.after(30, self._animate)

    def _skip(self) -> None:
        self._cancel_pending()
        self.app.show("menu")

    def _cancel_pending(self) -> None:
        for cb in (self._after_cb, self._anim):
            if cb is not None:
                try:
                    self.after_cancel(cb)
                except tk.TclError:
                    pass
        self.canvas.stop()

class QuestionScreen(tk.Frame):

        )
        self.progress_text.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=20, pady=8, sticky="w")

        self.score_text = tk.Label(
            self.topbar, text="Score: 0", bg=theme.PANEL, fg=theme.YELLOW,
            font=theme.font(18, "bold"),
        )
        self.score_text.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=20, pady=8)

        self.pause_btn = theme.big_button(
            self.topbar, "Pause", command=self._pause, bg=theme.PINK, size=16, pady=4,
        )
        self.pause_btn.grid(row=0, column=2, padx=20, pady=8, sticky="e")

        self.progress = tk.ttk.Progressbar(self.topbar, length=300, maximum=10)
        self.progress.grid(row=0, column=3, padx=20, pady=8)

        self.topbar.grid_columnconfigure(3, weight=1)

        # Question area
        self.question_label = tk.Label(
            self.canvas, text="", bg=theme.BG, fg=theme.TEXT,
            font=theme.font(30, "bold"), wraplength=900, justify="center",
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 180, window=self.question_label)

        self.feedback = tk.Label(
            self.canvas, text="", bg=theme.BG, fg=theme.GREEN,
            font=theme.font(26, "bold"),
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 340, window=self.feedback)

        self.answer_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.entry = tk.Entry(
            self.canvas, textvariable=self.answer_var, font=theme.font(22),
            width=20, justify="center",
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 430, window=self.entry)
        self.entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self._submit())

        self.submit_btn = theme.big_button(
            self.canvas, "Submit", command=self._submit, bg=theme.CYAN,
        )
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 520, window=self.submit_btn)

        # Multiple-choice option buttons (2x2 grid)
        self.option_frame = tk.Frame(self.canvas, bg=theme.BG)
        self.canvas.create_window(550, 430, window=self.option_frame)
        self._option_btns = []

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self.canvas.draw_background()
        self.canvas.twinkle()
        self._cancel_advance()
        self.app.start_round(10)
        self._show_next()

    def _show_next(self) -> None:
        q = self.app.next_question()
        if q is None:
            self._finish()
            return
        self._current_question = q
        idx = self.app.current_index
        total = len(self.app.round_questions)
        self.progress_text.configure(text=f"Question {idx} of {total}")
        self.progress.configure(maximum=total, value=idx - 1)
        self.score_text.configure(text=f"Score: {self.app.game.score}")
        self.feedback.configure(text="")
        self.answer_var.set("")
        self.question_label.configure(text=q.prompt)

        if q.is_multiple_choice():
            self._build_options(q)
            self.entry.place_forget()
            self.option_frame.place(x=550, y=430, anchor="center")
            self.canvas.delete("submit_placeholder")
        else:
            self._clear_options()
            self.option_frame.place_forget()
            self.entry.place(x=550, y=430, anchor="center")
            self.entry.focus_set()

    def _build_options(self, q) -> None:
        self._clear_options()
        self._option_btns = []
        colours = [theme.YELLOW, theme.CYAN, theme.PINK, theme.GREEN]
        for i, opt in enumerate(q.options):
            btn = theme.big_button(
                self.option_frame, opt, command=lambda o=opt: self._answer(o),
                bg=colours[i % len(colours)], width=16, size=18, pady=10,
            )
            btn.grid(row=i // 2, column=i % 2, padx=10, pady=10)
            self._option_btns.append(btn)

    def _clear_options(self) -> None:
        for b in self._option_btns:
            b.destroy()
        self._option_btns = []

    def _answer(self, value: str) -> None:
        self.answer_var.set(value)
        self._submit()

    def _submit(self) -> None:
        if self._current_question is None:
            return
        answer = self.answer_var.get().strip()
        if not answer:
            self.feedback.configure(text="Type an answer first!", fg=theme.RED)
            return
        correct = check_answer(self._current_question.answer, answer)
        self.app.game.record_answer(correct)
        self.score_text.configure(text=f"Score: {self.app.game.score}")
        if correct:
            self.feedback.configure(text="Correct! 🎉", fg=theme.GREEN)
        else:
            self.feedback.configure(
                text=f"Not quite — the answer is {self._current_question.answer}",
                fg=theme.RED,
            )
        self.answer_var.set("")  # cleared automatically
        self._pending_advance = self.after(1200, self._show_next)

    def _pause(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.app.game.pause()
        except Exception:
            return
        self.app.show("pause")

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.app.game.game_over()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.app.save_score()
        self.app.show("end")

    def _cancel_advance(self) -> None:
        if self._pending_advance is not None:
            try:
                self.after_cancel(self._pending_advance)
            except tk.TclError:
                pass
            self._pending_advance = None

            self.canvas, "Main menu", command=self._menu, bg=theme.MUTED, width=16,

        self.canvas.create_window(550, 580, window=self.menu_btn)

        self.canvas.draw_background()
        self.canvas.twinkle()
        game = self.app.game
        name = self.app.username or "Astronaut"
        self.title.configure(text=f"Congratulations, {name}!")
        if game is not None:
            self.score_label.configure(
                text=f"Score: {game.score} / {game.total}  ({game.percentage():.0f}%)"
            )
            stars = game.stars()
            self.stars_label.configure(text="★" * stars + "☆" * (3 - stars) or "No stars")
            if stars >= 3:
                self.encourage.configure(text="Out of this world! You're a fraction master! 🚀")
            elif stars >= 2:
                self.encourage.configure(text="Great job! Keep reaching for the stars!")
            elif stars >= 1:
                self.encourage.configure(text="Good effort! Practice makes perfect!")
            else:
                self.encourage.configure(text="Don't give up — try again, you'll get there!")
        self._confetti()

    def _confetti(self) -> None:
        self._stop_confetti()
        self._confetti_step()

    def _confetti_step(self, iteration: int = 0) -> None:
        if iteration > 60:
            self.canvas.delete("confetti")
            self._confetti_cb = None
            return
        self.canvas.delete("confetti")
        w = self.canvas.winfo_width() or 1100
        h = self.canvas.winfo_height() or 750
        for _ in range(40):

            y = random.randint(0, h)
            size = random.randint(4, 10)
            colour = random.choice(theme.ACCENTS)
            self.canvas.create_oval(x, y, x + size, y + size, fill=colour, outline="",
                                    tags="confetti")
        self._confetti_cb = self.after(120, lambda: self._confetti_step(iteration + 1))

    def _stop_confetti(self) -> None:
        if self._confetti_cb is not None:
            try:
                self.after_cancel(self._confetti_cb)
            except tk.TclError:
                pass
            self._confetti_cb = None

    def _again(self) -> None:
        self._stop_confetti()
        self.app.show("question")

    def _menu(self) -> None:
        self._stop_confetti()
        self.app.show("menu")

An educational fractions game for 6th-grade students, delivered as a single-user Windows
desktop application (Tkinter). Players answer a round of fraction questions in a fun,
